test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A chord of a circle of radius 21 cm makes a right angle at the center. Find the area of a major segment (take π = 22/7) closest to the nearest integer.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius = 21cm

The chord makes a right angle at the center.

**Formula used:**

Area of circle = pir²

Area of Triangle = 1/2 x base x height

Area of sector = {{pi times r² times theta } over 360^o}

Area of minor segment = Area of the minor sector - area of the triangle

Area of major segment = area of a circle - area of the minor segment

**Solution:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba421abd0bb4bc815e06afd9aca759bc41ef1bec3ded791ce766ae71aa2ef0a5.png] 

Area of circle = (22/7) x 21² = 1386cm²

Area of Triangle = 1/2 x 21 x 21 = 220.5cm²

Area of sector = {{{22over7} times 21² times 90^o } over 360^o} = 346.5cm²

Area of minor segment = 346.5 - 220.5 = 126cm²

**Area of major segment = 1386 - 126 = 1260cm²**
